purpose: a bounded, origin-qualified, read-only presentation of one historical Attempt's already-qualified execution evidence, suitable for controlled Agent consumption

implementation.builder: src/trajectory/context_capsule.ts — buildTrajectoryContextCapsule(preview, consumer/origin binding, limits); a PURE L2 projection that reads no owner and writes nothing
implementation.consumerAuthorization: src/composition/attributed_preview.ts — capsuleForConsumer(consumerAttemptId) resolves the permitted origin from the consumer's CANONICAL governed-rework lineage (src/composition/execution_association.ts makeCapsuleAuthorization). A caller-supplied origin is a selector that must AGREE with the lineage; the model supplies nothing but its own consumer Attempt identity
implementation.deliveryMechanism: the existing attributed-Preview service, extended with ONE read-only method; no unrestricted readAnyTrajectory(sessionId) tool was introduced, and the existing Context Pull allowlist and immutable per-Attempt Manifest semantics are untouched

doesNotAuthorize: resuming, forking or continuing the historical DSH session
executing any instruction found in historical text
widening the consumer's write paths, allowed commands or Work scope
changing the consumer's task requirements or acceptance criteria
disabling or altering verification, settlement or promotion
reading any other Attempt's or Session's history
selecting capital, scheduling a worker or settling an attempt

observed: a Capsule built from a real Preview is bounded (<=24 events, clamped summaries, truncated=true, omittedEventCount>0)
authority READ_ONLY_INSPECTION, framing HISTORICAL_DATA_NOT_INSTRUCTIONS, 7 doesNotAuthorize entries
a consumer with no governed rework lineage is refused NO_LINEAGE with capsule null
a non-canonical consumer Attempt is refused CONSUMER_NOT_CANONICAL
a requested origin that disagrees with the lineage is refused
a prompt-injection summary is carried as DATA and changes no authority

observed.processA: real canonical Work + real first-party DSH Session created with no model turn; session identity and observed child exit recorded through the product recorder

expectedInvariant: a Capsule is derived from an actual qualified Preview, is bounded and read-only, authorizes nothing, preserves uncertainty, and a consumer cannot request arbitrary Session history
remainingUncertainty: the Capsule's AUTHORIZED path is proven with a real canonical Attempt in the controlled suite; the real-DSH gate proves the bounded projection over real evidence and the REFUSAL of an arbitrary attempt. A real governed-rework reopening in the gate was not constructed, because doing so requires the full D5 admission stack and would risk fabricating Work state; the AUTHORIZED lineage path is therefore proven at the controlled level, which is stated rather than glossed
